title: repo-onboard configuration
description: Configuration for repo-onboard (https://www.npmjs.com/package/repo-onboard). AGENTS.md is the single source of truth; this file decides which tools get adapters and what goes into generated sections.

name.description: Project name, when it cannot be read from a manifest.

targets.description: AI tools to generate adapters for. AGENTS.md is always generated.

enabled.description: Generate CONTRIBUTING, ONBOARDING, ARCHITECTURE, ADRs, SECURITY and a PR template.

skills.description: Agent Skills in .agents/skills. Built-in: repo-onboard, run-checks, add-adr. Other names must exist as .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

nested.description: Generate AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md in each workspace package.

boundaries.description: Rendered into the Boundaries section of AGENTS.md.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers written to every enabled tool's config (.mcp.json, .vscode/mcp.json, .gemini/settings.json, .cursor/mcp.json, .codex/config.toml). Reference secrets as ${env:VAR}; never inline them.

ignore.description: Top-level folders to leave out of the repository map.
